Match its confident dark ink outlines, cel shaded anime illustration, lime yellow accents, cream, charcoal and small orange accents. Wide 16:9 1920x1080 composition, straight-on eye-level interior viewed from the front entrance, cozy original independent trading card and collectible shop. Warm wooden shelves along rear and left walls stocked with tasteful generic card packs, card boxes, a few collectible figures, parcels, tiny plants; no real brands. Rear center-left open standing area reserved for a separately composited shopkeeper, unobscured from head to knees, counter will be added separately so NO foreground counter in this plate. Right wall has a large perfectly rectangular blank dark charcoal widescreen display with lime thin frame, front facing, suitable for inserting real livestream or software footage. Inviting afternoon lighting, cream plaster, simple wooden floor with perspective toward rear wall, tidy cheerful detailed environment but calm areas for dialogue. No people, no cat mascot, no doorway frame, no foreground furniture blocking center, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Finished crisp high quality hand drawn anime game background, not 3D render, not pixel art. Fill frame edge-to-edge.
